blocks.source_text: SKIRT! SPREAD YOUR LEGS! I'LL CATCH IT FOR YOU!!
blocks.translation: váy của cô! Dang chân ra! Tôi bắt nó cho!!
blocks.notes: Continuation of the page-39 cut-off dialogue; lowercase Vietnamese start preserves the cross-page sentence.

blocks.source_text: CAN YOU SEE IT? CAN YOU? HURRY UP AND CATCH IT!!
blocks.translation: Cậu thấy nó không? Thấy không? Mau bắt nó đi!!

blocks.source_text: OH, I DON'T SEE IT! SPREAD THEM WIDER SO I CAN FIND IT!!
blocks.translation: Ơ, tôi không thấy! Dang rộng hơn nữa để tôi tìm!!
blocks.notes: Dialogue; suggestive wording preserved without adding detail.

blocks.source_text: WHAT ARE YOU DOING?! HURRY UP AND CATCH IT!!!
blocks.translation: Cậu làm gì thế?! Mau bắt nó đi!!!
